policy: Source-verified updates only. An hourly check may read approved machine-oriented official feeds, but new editorial entries require a primary source and a material change. Devpost observations are manual.

updates.title: WebMCP adds a consequential-action annotation
updates.summary: Commit 7b3f50f adds the consequentialHint tool annotation so clients and agents can identify actions with significant, real-world, or non-reversible effects and apply confirmation safeguards. The annotation is a signal rather than an enforcement mechanism; WebMCP remains an experimental Community Group draft, not a W3C Standard.

updates.title: WebMCP implementation status adds agent support
updates.summary: Commit 55fb7ee updates the draft report's implementation-status material to include agent support, and the canonical Community Group Report is now dated September 2, 2026. This is implementation-status evidence, not proof of support in every agent or browser; WebMCP remains an experimental Community Group draft, not a W3C Standard.

updates.title: Challenge organizers publish the halfway build checklist
updates.summary: The latest Devpost update asks builders to verify registered tools, a complete core flow, a deployed app, a public licensed repository, and a clear demo plan before the September 3 deadline.

updates.title: WebMCP Community Group Report dated August 26
updates.summary: The August 26 report defines the imperative browser API, lifecycle and exposure concepts, agent interaction model, and a growing security and privacy section. It remains a Community Group draft, not a W3C Standard.

updates.title: Chrome publishes a practical WebMCP tool-building guide
updates.summary: Chrome's guide walks through imperative registration, input schemas, tool results, annotations, state synchronization, feature detection, and cleanup for application developers.

updates.title: MCP maintainers publish a new protocol roadmap
updates.summary: The broader MCP project highlights agentic messaging, HTTP transport hardening, agent identity, enterprise security, improved primitives, and SDK experience. This is MCP ecosystem news, not a WebMCP browser API change.

updates.title: Cloudflare describes a remote-browser path to WebMCP
updates.summary: Cloudflare presents an approach for adding a WebMCP interface around existing sites with Browser Rendering and Workers. Treat it as one implementation pattern, not a change to the browser specification.

updates.title: MCP 2026-07-28 specification release ships
updates.summary: The broader MCP protocol release introduces a stateless core, discovery, cacheable list results, authorization hardening, and an extensions framework. WebMCP applications should track it for ecosystem alignment, but it is a separate specification.
